title: Symmetry breaking for the complex sine-Gordon equation
summary: We consider the existence of vortex solutions to the complex sine-Gordon II (CSG2) equation, which can be viewed as an analogy of the Ginzburg-Landau (GL) equation. Using the nontrivial kernels $η_{\pm}$ of the linearized CSG2 equation at the standard degree-2 vortex solution $Ψ_2$, we show that it bifurcating to a one-parameter family of symmetry-breaking solutions $Ψ_{2,α}$. Explicit formulas of these solutions are also available, from which we propose a new bilinear system for this equation. Our method can be generalized to higher degree case.
